title: Apple's iPhone shipments in China surge 20% in Q1, data shows
title_zh: 数据显示苹果第一季度iPhone在中国出货量猛增20%
summary: Apple's iPhone shipments surged 20% in China in the first quarter, for the strongest ‌growth among major vendors, despite an overall decline as rising prices ‌of memory chips boosted costs, data from Counterpoint Research showed.
summary_zh: Counterpoint Research 的数据显示，尽管存储芯片价格上涨推高了成本，导致整体下滑，但苹果第一季度 iPhone 在中国的出货量猛增 20%，在主要厂商中增长最为强劲。

title: Tesla seeks Taiwan chip engineers for Terafab project
title_zh: 特斯拉为 Terafab 项目寻找台湾芯片工程师
summary: By Wen-Yee Lee TAIPEI, April 17 (Reuters) - Tesla is seeking semiconductor engineers in Taiwan for its Terafab artificial intelligence chip complex, according to job postings on its website.
summary_zh: 作者：Wen-Yee Lee 台北，4 月 17 日（路透社）——根据特斯拉网站上的招聘信息，特斯拉正在台湾为其 Terafab 人工智能芯片联合体寻找半导体工程师。

title: ICE Director Lyons to Depart in May After Tumultuous Tenure
title_zh: ICE 主管 Lyons 在经历了动荡的任期后将于 5 月离职
summary: (Bloomberg) -- The acting head of US Immigration and Customs Enforcement will leave the agency at the end of May after a tumultuous year managing President Donald Trump’s mass arrest and deportation campaign.Todd Lyons has been the agency’s acting head since March 2025.
summary_zh: （彭博社）——美国移民和海关执法局代理负责人将于 5 月底离开该机构，此前他管理了唐纳德·特朗普总统的大规模逮捕和驱逐行动，经历了动荡的一年。托德·莱昂斯自 2025 年 3 月起一直担任该机构的代理负责人。
